replacement.sketch: No resource change required: makeDependencies builds pure service doubles and allocates applyCalls/observeCount inside each test. runProvisioning scopes construction; dry-run and explicit apply call counts remain separate. No live Box connection is acquired.

mutationCounts and mutationClient are module-owned, and rebuilding ApplierTestLayer does not recreate their counters. Allocate the client and counters per test before providing the applier, retaining all exact zero/one mutation assertions. Box.makeLayerFromClient is Layer.succeed, not external acquisition; a shared suite layer alone does not isolate these closures.

No resource change required: applyWithJournal allocates entries Ref and makeMutationClient counter per call, then scopes the injected journal and Box client. Recovery is an in-memory journal subject, not a persistent database.
No resource change required: sensitiveSentinels are inert synthetic strings passed to schema predicates. No credential lookup, Box service or file is acquired.
No resource change required: desired-state and folder-name checks are pure schema effects with no service layer or provider. Fixture adoptions remain data.

No resource change required: each client/options closure is built in its test, injected through pure Box.makeLayerFromClient and scoped. The pagination and HTTP failure shapes are doubles, not actual provider traffic.
No resource change required: planner operates on schema fixtures and derived digests without acquiring Box clients. Arrays are rebuilt rather than mutating shared fixture values.
No resource change required: this literal support file exports desired/observed/adoption records; callback URLs and provider IDs are fixture values. No resource is acquired at import.
